2121243670750085322.en_summary: $CRWV is seeking a $4B loan backed by $META contracts at ~7.5% which is well below 16% yield on its unsecured bonds. That’s higher than the 5.9% it secured in March but it also shows why having investment-grade customers locked into long-term contracts is so valuable when financing next wave of AI capacity.
2121243670750085322.zh_summary: $CRWV 正尋求一筆由 $META 合約擔保的 40 億美元貸款，利率約 7.5%，遠低於其無擔保債券 16% 的收益率。這高於三月份獲得的 5.9%，但也顯示了當融資下一波 AI 產能時，擁有投資級客戶鎖定長期合約的價值。

2121242931990344068.en_summary: Energy and gold sentiment just flipped. On Monday, $GLD sentiment stood at 86.77 versus just 28.26 for $XLE. By Thursday, the positions had reversed: XLE rose to 64.19 while GLD plunged to 3.92. In just three trading days, their sentiment gap swung 118.78 points, the largest shift toward XLE since 2015.
2121242931990344068.zh_summary: 能源與黃金情緒剛剛反轉。週一，$GLD 情緒為 86.77，而 $XLE 僅 28.26。到週四，位置反轉：XLE 升至 64.19，而 GLD 暴跌至 3.92。僅三個交易日，其情緒差距擺動 118.78 點，為自 2015 年以來最大向 XLE 的轉變。
